versions.changelog: RQNS pipeline, moltbooks, cheat codes, full optimization

Initial release of evez-github-manager.

- Manage GitHub repositories, pull requests, issues, and workflows from OpenClaw.
- Supports PR review automation, issue triage, branch management, and release coordination.
- Enables multi-repo workflow coordination and GitHub Actions status checks.
- Requires a GitHub token or Composio integration for authentication.
